                                   and doctor visit charges. In some policies surgeon fees is also clubbed under room rent Food 
                                   ordered for anyone apart from patient is not covered under room rent.

When a person admitted in the intensive care unit (ICU) the daily charges for the same will be
                                  payable, this would also inculde operation theater charges in some cases.

The expenses incurred by a insured person prior to hospitalization on a account of Doctor visit, 
                                   tests conducted or any other medical procedures undertaken are termed as pere hospitalization expenses. 
                                   Generally, policies cover expenses incurred for a duration of 30 to 60 days prior hospitalization.

The expenses incurred after being discharged from the hospital on account of doctor visits, 
                                   Post-operative procedures, other medical procedure are termed as post hospitalization expenses. 
                                   Generally, Policies cover expenses incurred for a duration of 60 to 120 days after hospitalization.

Under this benefit, if you consume the complete sum insured under a policy due to one or more 
                                   hospitalizations, then again you will be eligible to use the entire sum insured within the policy period.
                                   For restoration to be implemented the admissible claim amount will be considered, If a person putrs a 
                                   claim and there are deductions that portion will be excluded from the restoration element.

When you claim co-pay will be the amount which will be deducted from your admissible claim amount since 
                                   it's a policy condition. All insurance policies do not have a co pay condition. If a co pay condition 
                                   is present your policy it could applicable due on claims for certain ailments, Claims for dependents 
                                   parents or all members, claims for members above certain age  or not adhering to certain policy 
                                   conditions.

When a policy renewed without lodging a claim, a benefit can be availed be the customer. This benefit could be 
                                   in the form of a discount in premium or increase in sum insured.

                                      incurred for hospitalization and procedure  for donor is also covered. Traditionally insurance 
                                      policies would cover the cost of a surgery of organ donation only for the policy holder. However 
                                      now it is possible to cover the hospitalization and surgery expenses of the donor also. Costs of 
                                      pre and post hospitalization costs of the donor and costs on account of post- surgery complication 
                                      are not generally not covered under insurance.

Out door patient treatment does not involve hospitalization. Here you meet a doctor  for consultaion 
                                   and are prescribed to take medicines or undergo tests or other medical procedure.

Under this benefit a female who is covered under the policy can claim expenses incurred on account of 
                                   child birth during hospitalization upto the limit of the cover. In retail insurance policies waiting 
                                   period of 2 Years or more may apply on the coverage. Generally pre hospitalization and post hospitalization 
                                   expenses are not covered under the maternity benefit.

                                      would put the baby or mother at risk.

Under this benefit after child birth expenses incurred for vaccination which are prescribed as per 
                                   medical board are covered. The charges will have to be validated as per the guideline provided by 
                                   medical board.

When this cover is availed, the new born baby gets covered under the policy as an insured instantly 
                                   after birth without payment of additional premium.
